name: pollen-robotics/microduck
registry_description: The robot's software: `robotd` 50 Hz control loop, `mediad` camera/WebRTC, `padd` gamepad, updater, the official policy set and the `robotctl policy` channel that installs community policies from the Hub.

name: microduck_os
registry_description: The robot's operating system: a Yocto image for the RK3566 that boots straight into the daemons and updates itself with signed A/B bundles that roll back when a new slot does not come up healthy. It boots, updates and rolls back on a Radxa Zero 3W stand-in, and is in bring-up on the first custom board.

name: pollen-robotics/microduck_rl
registry_description: RL training environments on mjlab (MuJoCo Warp) with PPO, BAM actuator models, backlash simulation and domain randomization. Needs a CUDA GPU.

name: pollen-robotics/microduck-gst-plugins
registry_description: Prebuilt aarch64 GStreamer plugins (Rockchip MPP encoders, gst-plugins-rs WebRTC) used by the on-robot media daemon.

name: Microduck Sandbox
registry_description: Official in-browser simulator: MuJoCo compiled to WebAssembly plus onnxruntime-web running the real policies at 50 Hz, with gamepad support and the roller-skate variant.

name: Microduck Console
registry_description: Official hosted console for driving a duck that is not on your own network, over WebRTC and Hugging Face sign-in.

name: Policy Playground
registry_description: Official Space that reads every `microduck-` policy on the Hub the way the robot reads it and installs one onto your duck in one click, through the same calls `robotctl policy add` makes.

name: Vision demo
registry_description: Official Space that takes the duck's camera feed and runs the processing on Hugging Face hardware instead of on the robot.

name: Microduck Arena
registry_description: Official leaderboard that races submitted policies server-side over five perturbed seeds at every speed in the event's sweep, so board times reproduce. Events: 2 m sprint, 2 m roller sprint, 1.5 m hill climb, Got a Talent (voted performances) and Tug of War (duels over a pit, with a weekly cup) and Sock Heist (a 6 m dash to a giant duck's nest, freezing whenever it looks). Runs locally too; [source](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck-arena).

name: Vet book
registry_description: Official Space that turns a robot's vet book, the record `robotctl vetbook` keeps of hours awake, metres walked, falls, tricks and every servo replaced, into a shareable card once the owner publishes it to their own Hugging Face account.

name: microduck-policies
registry_description: The ten official ONNX policies as a standalone Apache-2.0 repository on the Hugging Face Hub, described by one schema-2 `manifest.json`, with `velstand` the default walk since 14 September.

name: microduck-training
registry_description: Official full training checkpoints behind the shipped policies, with weights, normalisers, optimiser state and curriculum step, each mapped to the exported ONNX and the code commit, so training can resume from them with `--init-checkpoint`.

name: Arena reference policies
registry_description: Pollen's reproducible baselines for each Arena event: 2 m sprint, [2 m roller sprint](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-roller-sprint-2m-reference), [1.5 m hill climb](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-hill-climb-1m5-reference) a [Got a Talent](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-got-a-talent-reference) sit-and-stand reference and a [6 m Sock Heist](https://huggingface.co/pollen-robotics/microduck-sock-heist-6m-reference). The [challenge repository](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck-challenges) has one training folder per event, each with an `AGENTS.md` for coding agents.

name: microduck-emotions
registry_description: Official Apache-2.0 dataset of emotional body-language animations, published so the duck and Reachy Mini can act scenes together. The [design repository](https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_emotions) behind it holds the 14 emotions as keyframes and sounds, a runtime patch that plays them from the gamepad, and the duck's voice synthesiser in Python.

name: microduck-duck-detector
registry_description: Official one-class detector that finds *other* ducks in a duck's own camera, shipped as PyTorch, ONNX and INT8 RKNN for the robot's NPU and run on board by `duck-detect`. Scored at 0.80 mAP50, with every training run kept as a Git tag.

name: pollen-robotics/duck_detector
registry_description: The Apache-2.0 pipeline behind that model: capture, label, train and quantize, end to end.
